Bug_Title: Dm: Futile attempt to change max pool size of ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor (DMI_FUTILE_ATTEMPT_TO_CHANGE_MAXPOOL_SIZE_OF_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR)
Bug_Details:
(Javadoc)
While ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor inherits from ThreadPoolExecutor, a few of the inherited tuning methods are not useful for it. In particular, because it acts as a fixed-sized pool using corePoolSize threads and an unbounded queue, adjustments to maximumPoolSize have no useful effect.
Bug_Explanation: The code attempts to change the maximum pool size of a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor using setMaximumPoolSize. However, this operation is futile because ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor uses a fixed core pool size and an unbounded queue, making the maximum pool size setting irrelevant.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method, which attempts to change the maximum pool size of a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor. This is futile because the executor uses a fixed core pool size and an unbounded queue. The attempt is made on line 12 of the original code and is reflected in the JUnit test by failing the test to highlight the bug.
